ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - CACTUSTORCH Remote Thread Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects remote thread creation from CACTUSTORCH as described in references. Note: Unmapped fields: SourceImage, TargetImage, StartModule

sequences.query: ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\System32\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\System32\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\System32\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$")) AND TargetImage = RGX(".*\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*") AND StartModule = "None")
